# Privacy policy — Revit Family DLL Builder

Publisher: Mostafa Magdy  
Effective: 19 October 2026

## Scope

This policy describes the Revit Family DLL Builder skill package and support
provided by its publisher. The package contains instructions, reference files,
sample C# source, and a local build helper. It does not include a publisher-hosted
service, analytics, advertising, or a telemetry endpoint.

## Documents, generated files, and logs

The assistant may read documents and source files you provide or authorize it to
access for a family-generation task. These can contain project information and
personal data. The assistant's host processes those inputs under its own privacy
policy, account settings, and controls. Installing this package does not give
the publisher access to your conversations or project files.

The supplied workflow creates local source, DLLs, family files, and diagnostic
logs. Logs can include local paths, assembly identifiers, Revit build details,
timestamps, element identifiers, and error details. They are intended for local
diagnosis. The packaged code does not transmit them to the publisher. They remain
on your computer until you remove them or another tool acts on your instructions.
You can inspect, redact, or delete these local files.

## GitHub support information

Support is provided through the repository's public GitHub Issues page:
https://github.com/moustafamagdi/revit-family-dll-skill/issues

If you open an issue, GitHub may display your account name, issue text, comments,
timestamps, and any attachments you choose to submit. These are visible to the
publisher and other people who can view the public repository. Do not include
credentials, confidential manufacturer documents, private project information,
or unredacted logs. Submit only the minimum information needed to reproduce the issue.

The publisher uses information submitted for support only to investigate,
respond to, and resolve issues. The publisher does not sell that information
or use it for marketing. GitHub hosts this support information under its own
terms, privacy policy, and user controls.

## Retention and removal

Support information is kept while the issue or comment remains available on
GitHub. To request removal, use your GitHub editing/deletion controls where
available, or contact the publisher through the repository's Issues page without
repeating the sensitive information. The publisher handles removal requests
through GitHub where possible. Removal from the repository cannot guarantee
removal of independent copies, caches, or information retained by GitHub.

The publisher does not set the retention period for conversations or files held
by the assistant's host. Use the host's controls and policy for those records.

## Changes and contact

Policy updates will be published with an updated date. For a privacy question,
contact Mostafa Magdy through the repository's Issues page, using a minimal,
non-sensitive description.
